# Dawn

Dawn is a dawn-inspired theme with soft light and dark modes, a spacious interface and an emphasis on readability. It polishes Markdown editing and previews, styles blockquotes and callouts, and adds support for mobile view and plugins such as To-Do, Dataview and Canvas.

![Dawn screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ds-package/Dawn/HEAD/assets/00-screenshot-small.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Dawn"
    author: "ds-package"
    repo:   "ds-package/Dawn"
    slug:   "dawn"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/dawn"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/ds-package/Dawn"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ds-package/Dawn/HEAD/assets/00-screenshot-small.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply Dawn for a serene, dawn-inspired look with soft light and dark modes, a spacious UI, and improved readability. Polish Markdown editing and previews, style blockquotes and callouts, and add support for mobile view and popular plugins like To-Do, Dataview, and Canvas."
}
```
